_meta.description: Grouped Process summing revenue by month on orders.pulse decorated with an OVERLAY_ZSCORE_VS_ROLLING group overlay: each month against the mean and sample SD of the 3 months before it (params.window 3), (point - rolling_mean) / rolling_sd. A point needs params.min_periods earlier present points (2 to the window, default the window) and is null before that, with no warning, so the first three months are null; July stands out at about +3.4. A zero rolling SD emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO. Sibling of OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_ROLLING_MEAN (28_process_index_vs_rolling_mean.json). Buffered; renderers centre colour ramps on baseline 0.
_meta.name: process-zscore-vs-rolling
